league.name: Leagues: CATALYST
league.purpose_in_dataset: Historical baseline for comparing League II progression, relic power, XP multipliers and task economy. Do not assume Catalyst mechanics carry into Equilibrium.

passives: Crops grow 5x faster.
Run energy does not drain.
+20% hit chance.
The Archaeology Guild Shop is fully available.
Necromancy rituals grant +400% souls.
Thaler gain is multiplied by 4.
Rare items are twice as common.
Slayer task assignment offers a choice between two tasks.
Slayer task size can be chosen at the minimum or maximum amount.
Slayer and Reaper points are multiplied by 5.
Movement ability cooldowns are reduced to 4.8 seconds.
Dive is automatically unlocked.
Rare items are 4x as common as the base game.
All tool-belt items are unlocked.
Gate of Elidinis access is enabled, although Soul Searching is still needed for its surrounding area.
Ancient Curses are unlocked.
Soul Reaper task can be chosen.
Zemouregal & Vorkath and Amascut become available without their normal quest requirements.
The Sage can swap spellbooks and prayer books.
Ancient Magicks are unlocked.
Lunar Magic and most Lunar spells are unlocked.
All Seren spells and prayers are unlocked.
Ring of vigour becomes a passive effect.
Rare items are 6x as common as the base game.
Advance Time can be used without limit.

effects: Fishing can be performed without bait and receives a large catch-rate improvement.
Caught fish can be automatically cooked.
Hunter catches cannot fail and Hunter loot is doubled.
Special boots periodically award Agility XP.
Agility course completion XP is heavily increased.
Agility obstacles cannot be failed.
Course laps award coins based on Agility level.
Thieving checks do not fail.
Thieving loot is automatically noted.
Stalls do not deplete.
Safe cooldown is reduced to roughly one minute.
Farming harvest actions are instantaneous.
Seeds grow immediately after planting.
Patches behave as if treated with ultracompost.
Seeds can be saved and crop yields are increased.
Provides a reusable teleport interface for fairy rings, spirit trees and farming patches.
Necromancy basic attacks generate double adrenaline.
Necromancy ability and special-attack cooldowns are reduced by 20%.
Necromancy has 100% hit chance.
Conjured spirits are larger and deal 25% more damage.
Ectoplasm and rune consumption has a 95% save chance.
All Well of Souls abilities are unlocked.
Items can be noted or unnoted almost anywhere.
Provides near-universal bank access utility.
Provides effectively unlimited Invention materials.
Augmented equipment and machines consume no charge.
Beneficial perks trigger 10% more often where applicable.
Invention machines operate twice as fast.
Manual disassembly and alchemy can award both classes of resulting resources.
There is a 66% chance to save a resource used in relevant Invention operations.
All Dwarven and Goblin Technology blueprints are unlocked.

equilibrium_comparison_notes: Catalyst did not use region locking; Equilibrium does.
Catalyst bundled combat power into relics and global tier passives; Equilibrium separates combat power into an 8-tier Blessing tree.
Equilibrium is advertised as faster to enter its high-power state, with more auto-completed quests and earlier combat power.
Catalyst aura-era assumptions are legacy because the 2026 Aura Overhaul removed the aura system.
